Class: EQ Machine Gun • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: Battle Rifle

Damage: 8d6 • Capacity: 800 • ROF: 1/2 • Hands: 0

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Gun 5)

Concealable: No

Open Slots: N/A • Attachments: Auto-Compensator, Power Rebuild, Smartgun Link

Special Features: This weapon has two modes: Automatic and Hyper-Burst. Swapping between modes does not take an Action, and can be done any time the user makes an attack.

In Automatic Mode, this weapon can only use Autofire at ROF 2. Either half of ROF 2 Autofire can be an Autofire Attack or Suppressive Fire. Using Autofire with this weapon expends 20 rounds of ammunition.

In Hyper-Burst mode, this weapon can only fire in Single Shot at ROF 1, expending 180 rounds on every Attack. Hyper-Burst Attacks ignore half of a target’s SP (Round Up), function as an Explosive for the purposes of carrying damage to targets behind Cover, and if it would ablate armor, ablates 4 additional SP (5 SP Normal / 6 SP Armor-Piercing).

Cost: Part of the Militech SPECTER
Range: Battle Rifle
Pre-installed: Auto-Compensator, Power Rebuild, Smartgun Link (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Gun 5)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Gear, Drugs, & Frames > External Linear Frames).
